subject: mb-3-cs-b16-app1-domain-map
intent: Show Mybizz CS's domain - the glossary's entities and their relationships - so a reader trusts that every entity has one owner and one place in the data design, and that the trade/common marking holds. Load-bearing claim: the contact is the spine every trade record links to - the one direction the rule allows - and Mybizz's own billing (plan summary, referrals) is written only from the App 5 and Paddle side, never becoming a money record of the client's business. Audience: David at the gate, then Step 17, which builds the tables from this vocabulary.
type_reason: Entities and their ownership and relationships; the default for everything that exists and connects; not a flow or a state picture.

node_roles.client-business: common - the subscribing business, owner of every record below it
node_roles.contact: common - the customer as one person; the spine every trade record links to
node_roles.provider: common - the user who delivers services
node_roles.service: trade - the catalogue offering, bookable or unit-priced
node_roles.booking: trade - of a service or package; sessions drawn down
node_roles.order: trade - delivered work, with its brief and delivery
node_roles.quote: trade - the offer whose acceptance creates the invoice
node_roles.invoice: trade - the money claim, with its lines and tax
node_roles.payment: trade - money taken or refunded, by gateway or by hand
node_roles.crm-outreach: common - one node for the cluster: leads, enquiries, segments, campaigns, tasks, email; deals stay trade, deferred to a card
node_roles.mybizz-billing: common - plan, subscription, referral, plan summary, written from the App 5 and Paddle side

deferred_to_cards: Customer package - the card states that a booking draws down one session of a customer package
the public-website cluster (Page, Blog post, Landing page, Media file)
the legal cluster (Legal document, Consent record)
the platform cluster (Client instance, Release image, Vault, Notification)
layout_budget_read: renderers/architecture/ - no README with a layout budget for this type; free-form grid.mjs
quality_gate: showcase accepted only at 9 artifact checks, 0 composition errors, 0 warnings
abort_conditions: node overlap surviving the repair order
an edge through a node surviving the repair order
an ambiguous shared corridor surviving the repair order
